title: v1.1.0 - Mobile UI/UX Redesign & Detail Popup Modal
release_notes:
### 📱 Mobile UI/UX Redesign & Detail Popup Modal

- **46px Ultra-Compact Milestone Tiles**: Redesigned mobile cards into compact glanceable rows.
- **Logo-Only Filter Ribbon**: Single horizontal row of brand icons with zero text wrapping.
- **Detail Modal Popup (Bottom-Sheet)**: Tap any model to view 4-cell tech specs and full description.
- **Eliminated Top Header Clutter**: Top bar streamlined; view switching handled by bottom dock.
- **Bilingual Support**: Localized English and Chinese modal labels.
